revisions.status: Native vehicle baseline read; clean factory naturally aspirated architecture with returnless ERFS
revisions.summary: Native baseline read from Nic's vehicle environment. Features genuine returnless ERFS (0-70 psi FRPS, 0.484 vacuum mult), but lacks forced induction calibration (stock 30 lb injectors, 25-35 deg NA spark advance, factory NA cam overlap).

revisions.status: Official clean candidate ready for pre-flash review and first idle datalog
revisions.summary: Clean forced induction baseline derived directly from SVT Tune.hpt: scaled to Siemens Deka 60 lb/hr injectors (ECM 12011/10/12/13), expanded and clamped spark timing to safe 11.0°-11.5° ceiling on Load 2.00 (ECM 44583), applied v037 VCT reversion lockout (ECM 44412), lowered cooling fan triggers to 196°F/205°F, and raised idle target to 950 RPM (ECM 44218/17) while preserving 100% of factory returnless ERFS architecture.
parameter_changes: ECM 12011 (Injector Flow Rate High: 0.009670 -> 0.016700 lb/s [60.1 lb/hr])
ECM 12010 (Injector Flow Rate Low: 0.010100 -> 0.017500 lb/s [63.0 lb/hr])
ECM 44583 (Spark Borderline Knock: Load 2.00 boost ceiling clamped to 10.75°-11.50° BTDC)
ECM 44412 (VCT Angle vs. RPM vs. Load: applied v037 reversion lockout flat 0.00° across 4,500-7,200 RPM and in boost >3,500 RPM)
System Fans (Fan Low Speed: 216.0 -> 196.0°F / Fan High Speed: 228.0 -> 205.0°F)
